title: The Battle of the Labyrinth
author: Rick Riordan
summary: The fourth Percy Jackson book. As a war with the Titans looms, the young demigods have to find a way through a vast, shifting maze beneath the modern world, where one wrong turn leads somewhere dangerous.
readIf: you like kids' adventure with big stakes, fun monsters and a tightening sense of a final conflict.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since the plot depends on them.

pairings.reason: Another series where the fourth book turns darker and the heroes are forced to grow up.
A classic quest through a wondrous, maze-like fantasy world, with a more dreamlike feel.
A young hero heads into a dangerous, larger world full of intrigue and unusual creatures.
